12	/-!
13	# The tangent space of `Pic⁰_{C/k}` in its étale formulation
14	
15	The Kleiman §5 Thm. `thm:tgtsp` dimension development for `Scheme.Pic0SchemeEt C`
16	— the identity component of the scheme representing the **étale-sheafified**
17	relative Picard functor, which is the object the Jacobian headline binds
18	(`picardJacobianWitness`, `AlgebraicJacobian/Jacobian.lean`).
19	
20	## Why this file exists
21	
22	`Picard/Pic0AbelianVariety.lean` develops the same chain for `Pic0Scheme C`, the
23	identity component of the scheme representing the *unsheafified* `picSharp C`.
24	That development carries `[HasPicScheme C]`, a class with no instance whose only
25	producer is the conditional `picSchemeOfHasRationalPoint` — so it is a statement
26	about a *pointed* curve, and the headline's dimension leaf
27	`smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus_pic0Et` cannot consume it.
28	
29	## What this file corrects
30	
31	`Jacobian.lean` priced the étale dimension leaf as needing "the comparison of the
32	two Picard schemes, which is available only under a section" — i.e. exactly the
33	hypothesis the owner decision `I-0491` forbids the headline to carry. **That
34	pricing is wrong, and this file is the refutation.** Every engine of the
35	dual-number leg is quantified over an arbitrary functor and an arbitrary
36	`RepresentableBy`:
37	
38	* `Pic0.pointedDualNumberPointsEquivRepresentableFiber` and
39	  `pointedDualNumberPointsEquivAddKernel`
40	  (`Picard/Pic0DualNumberCocycle.lean`) take `(G, rep)` as arguments;
41	* `pointedDualNumberPointsEquivOfOpenImmersion` (`Picard/Pic0TangentSpace.lean`)
42	  takes an arbitrary morphism with open-immersion underlying map;
43	* `overDualNumberSectionEquivCotangentSpaceDual`
44	  (`Picard/TangentSpaceIdentitySection.lean`) takes an arbitrary `X` and section.
45	
46	`picSharp` entered only at the two *application* sites of
47	`Pic0AbelianVariety.lean`. Here the same engines are applied to
48	`(PicSharp.etaleSheaf C).obj` with `representableEt` — which is precisely the
49	`(G, rep)` pair they ask for, and which needs no rational point.
50	
51	## What is proved and what remains
52	
53	Proved outright, with no rational point and no `[HasPicScheme C]`:
54	`identitySection`, `pointedDualNumberPoints_equiv_cotangentSpaceDual`,
55	`pointedDualNumberPoints_equiv_relPicEtKernel` (the representability leg **against
56	`picEt`**), `cotangentSpaceDual_equiv_relPicEtKernel`, and
57	`finiteDimensional_cotangentSpace`.
58	
59	**What "axiom-clean" does and does not mean here**, since every declaration in this file
60	binds `[HasPicSchemeEt C]` and `#print axioms` on each reports only
61	`[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. That is a statement about the *implications*: a
62	bound instance argument is never unfolded. At any real use site the unconditional
63	`instHasPicSchemeEt` fires, and its body is `(fgaPicardRepresentability C).1` — the
64	project's central `sorry`. So instantiating any declaration below at a bare curve reports
65	`sorryAx`. The honest phrasing, which the commit messages should have used: these add **no
66	new `sorry`**, and are axiom-clean *conditional on the `sorry`-backed `HasPicSchemeEt`
67	gate*. Nothing in this file is unconditional in the stronger sense of holding for a curve
68	today. Recorded after a fresh-context audit (`I-0988`).
69	
70	The dimension identity itself is stated as an **implication**. Its single antecedent is
71	`SemilinearCotangentComparisonEt`, which is clause for clause the same *shape* as the
72	`picSharp` side's own open residue
73	`Pic0.semilinearComparison_cotangentSpaceDual_h1Cok` (`Pic0AbelianVariety.lean`, a bare
74	`sorry`): same `∀ S`, same `∃ i j`, same bijectivity, same intertwining. This file adds
75	**no `sorry` of its own**; the antecedent is a named hypothesis, not a discharged
76	obligation.
77	
78	**It is one statement, but not the *same* statement — corrected after a fresh-context
79	audit (`I-0989`).** An earlier version of this paragraph said the étale formulation owes
80	"the same one statement the pointed formulation owes, and no more". The count is right and
81	the shape is right; the identification is not. The two antecedents compare **different
82	carriers**:
83	
84	* on the `picSharp` side the kernel is a kernel of `PicSharp.relPresheaf`, whose elements
85	  are honest invertible-sheaf classes (a quotient of `LineBundle.OnProduct`), and the
86	  residue is priced there as a Čech-to-invertible-sheaves comparison at a non-affine
87	  scheme;
88	* here the kernel description lands in a kernel of `(PicSharp.etaleSheaf C).obj` — the
89	  **sheafification** — so its elements are sheafification classes.
90	
91	Reusing the `picSharp` cocycle argument therefore needs a bridge from the sheafified
92	kernel back to the presheaf kernel at `Spec k[ε]`, and no such lemma exists in the
93	project. The two agree under a section (`picEtComparison_isIso_of_hasRationalPoint`), which
94	is exactly the hypothesis `I-0491` forbids and that this formulation exists to avoid. So
95	the étale antecedent additionally absorbs the sheafification-versus-presheaf step: not
96	extra `sorry`s and not a weakening, but unnamed cost inside a named hypothesis, named here.
97	
98	What this file does **not** do, stated plainly because it is easy to overread:
99	it does not close the headline leaf `smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus_pic0Et`.
100	That leaf needs, over and above the dimension count, the passage from a
101	tangent-space dimension to Mathlib's presentation-based
102	`SmoothOfRelativeDimension` (characterised by `Module.rank S Ω[S⁄R]`), plus
103	`Pic0Et.smooth` itself. Those are recorded on the leaf and are untouched here.
104	
105	## References
106	
107	Kleiman, "The Picard scheme" (arXiv:math/0504020), §5 Thm. `thm:tgtsp`.
108	Mumford, "Abelian varieties", §II.4 (the tangent-vector scaling).
109	-/

125	/-! ## §1. The identity section of `Pic⁰_{C/k}` -/
126	
127	/-- **The `k`-rational identity-section point of `Pic⁰_{C/k}`**, étale
128	formulation: the lift of the identity section of `PicSchemeEt C` through the
129	clopen immersion `Pic⁰_{C/k} ↪ Pic_{C/k}`.
130	
131	`GroupScheme.identityComponentSection` needs `[GrpObj G]` and
132	`[LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom]` on `G = PicSchemeEt C`; both are available with no
133	hypothesis on `C(k)` — the first from `groupSchemeStructureEt` (Yoneda transport
134	of the étale sheaf's abelian-group structure) and the second from
135	`instPicSchemeEtLocallyOfFiniteType`. This is the étale counterpart of
136	`Pic0.identitySection`, which carries `[HasPicScheme C]`. -/
137	noncomputable def identitySection (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
138	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
139	    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicSchemeEt C] :
140	    Spec (.of k) ⟶ (Pic0SchemeEt C).left :=
141	  GroupScheme.identityComponentSection (PicSchemeEt C)
142	
143	/-- The identity-section point is a genuine section of the structural morphism.
144	Transport of `GroupScheme.identityComponentSection_isSection`. -/
145	theorem identitySection_isSection (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
146	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
147	    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicSchemeEt C] :
148	    identitySection C ≫ (Pic0SchemeEt C).hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k)) :=
149	  GroupScheme.identityComponentSection_isSection (PicSchemeEt C)
150	
151	/-- The residue field of the local ring at the identity of `Pic⁰_{C/k}`. -/
152	noncomputable abbrev identityResidueField (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
153	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
154	    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicSchemeEt C] :=
155	  ResidueField ((Pic0SchemeEt C).left.presheaf.stalk ((identitySection C).base default))
156	
157	/-- The Zariski cotangent space `m_e/m_e²` at the identity of `Pic⁰_{C/k}`. -/
158	noncomputable abbrev identityCotangentSpace (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
159	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
160	    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicSchemeEt C] :=
161	  CotangentSpace ((Pic0SchemeEt C).left.presheaf.stalk ((identitySection C).base default))
162	
163	/-! ## §2. The two legs of Kleiman §5 Thm. `thm:tgtsp`, étale formulation -/
164	
165	/-- **The Stacks 0B28 dictionary at the identity**, étale formulation: pointed
166	dual-number points of `Pic⁰_{C/k}` at the identity biject with `κ(e)`-linear
167	functionals on the cotangent space `m_e/m_e²`.
168	
169	Direct specialisation of `overDualNumberSectionEquivCotangentSpaceDual`
170	(`Picard/TangentSpaceIdentitySection.lean`) to `e = identitySection C`; that
171	engine is generic in the scheme and the section, so this needs nothing about
172	`picEt` beyond the section being a section. Étale counterpart of
173	`Pic0.pointedDualNumberPoints_equiv_cotangentSpaceDual`. -/
174	theorem pointedDualNumberPoints_equiv_cotangentSpaceDual (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
175	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
176	    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicSchemeEt C] :
177	    Nonempty (Pic0.pointedDualNumberPoints (Pic0SchemeEt C) (identitySection C) ≃
178	      Module.Dual (identityResidueField C) (identityCotangentSpace C)) := by
179	  haveI : Subsingleton ↥(Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
180	    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum k))
181	  exact ⟨overDualNumberSectionEquivCotangentSpaceDual (Pic0SchemeEt C)
182	    (identitySection_isSection C) (congrArg _ (Subsingleton.elim _ _))⟩
183	
184	/-- **The representability leg, against `picEt` and with no rational point** —
185	the declaration whose absence `Jacobian.lean` priced as a section-gated
186	transport.
187	
188	`T_e Pic⁰_{C/k}` biject with the kernel of the restriction homomorphism
189	`Pic_{(C/k)ét}(Spec k[ε]) →+ Pic_{(C/k)ét}(Spec k)`. Composite of
190	
191	1. the open-immersion transport `T_e Pic⁰ ≃ T_e Pic` along the clopen inclusion
192	   (`pointedDualNumberPointsEquivOfOpenImmersion`), and
193	2. the represented-functor kernel description
194	   (`pointedDualNumberPointsEquivAddKernel`) applied at
195	   `G = (PicSharp.etaleSheaf C).obj` — the `AddCommGrpCat`-valued étale Picard
196	   sheaf — with `rep = representableEt C`.
197	
198	Step 2 is the whole point: that engine takes an arbitrary `AddCommGrpCat`-valued
199	`G` together with a `RepresentableBy` for `G ⋙ forget`, and by definition
200	`picEt C = (PicSharp.etaleSheaf C).obj ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat`
201	(`Picard/PicEtSheaf.lean`), so `representableEt C` **is** that datum. No
202	comparison between the two Picard schemes occurs anywhere in the proof, and the
203	étale-sheafified functor is the one whose kernel is described.
204	
205	Étale counterpart of `Pic0.pointedDualNumberPoints_equiv_relPicKernel`. Like it,
206	this is a bijection of **sets**: transporting `finrank` needs the `k`-linearity
207	bookkeeping, which stays with the dimension identity below. -/
208	theorem pointedDualNumberPoints_equiv_relPicEtKernel (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
209	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
210	    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicSchemeEt C] :
211	    Nonempty (Pic0.pointedDualNumberPoints (Pic0SchemeEt C) (identitySection C) ≃
212	      {a : ((PicSharp.etaleSheaf C).obj).obj (Opposite.op (overDualNumber k)) //
213	        (((PicSharp.etaleSheaf C).obj).map (overDualNumberZero k).op).hom a = 0}) := by
214	  obtain ⟨f, hopen, -⟩ :=
215	    GroupScheme.IdentityComponent.isOpenSubgroupScheme (PicSchemeEt C)
216	  haveI := hopen
217	  have he' : (identitySection C ≫ f.left) ≫ (PicSchemeEt C).hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k)) :=
218	    (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
219	      ((congrArg (fun t => identitySection C ≫ t) (Over.w f)).trans
220	        (identitySection_isSection C))
221	  exact ⟨(pointedDualNumberPointsEquivOfOpenImmersion f (identitySection C)).trans
222	    (pointedDualNumberPointsEquivAddKernel (PicSchemeEt C)
223	      ((PicSharp.etaleSheaf C).obj) (representableEt C) he')⟩
224	
225	/-- **The two legs composed**, étale formulation: the `κ(e)`-linear dual of the
226	cotangent space at the identity of `Pic⁰_{C/k}` bijects with the dual-number
227	kernel of `Pic_{(C/k)ét}`. Étale counterpart of
228	`Pic0.cotangentSpaceDual_equiv_relPicKernel`, and a bijection of sets for the
229	same reason. -/
230	theorem cotangentSpaceDual_equiv_relPicEtKernel (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
231	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
232	    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicSchemeEt C] :
233	    Nonempty (Module.Dual (identityResidueField C) (identityCotangentSpace C) ≃
234	      {a : ((PicSharp.etaleSheaf C).obj).obj (Opposite.op (overDualNumber k)) //
235	        (((PicSharp.etaleSheaf C).obj).map (overDualNumberZero k).op).hom a = 0}) := by
236	  obtain ⟨φ⟩ := pointedDualNumberPoints_equiv_cotangentSpaceDual C
237	  obtain ⟨ψ⟩ := pointedDualNumberPoints_equiv_relPicEtKernel C
238	  exact ⟨φ.symm.trans ψ⟩
239	
240	/-- Finite-dimensionality of the cotangent space at the identity, from the
241	unconditional `Pic0Et.locallyOfFiniteType`. Needed for the duality step of the
242	dimension chain. -/
243	theorem finiteDimensional_cotangentSpace (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
244	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
245	    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicSchemeEt C] :
246	    FiniteDimensional (identityResidueField C) (identityCotangentSpace C) := by
247	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (Pic0SchemeEt C).hom := locallyOfFiniteType C
248	  exact Pic0.finiteDimensional_cotangentSpace_of_locallyOfFiniteType (Pic0SchemeEt C) _
249	
250	/-! ## §3. The dimension identity, as an implication with one named antecedent -/
251	
252	/-- **The one open input of the étale dimension count**, named so that the
253	implication below has an auditable antecedent rather than a `sorry`.
254	
255	This is the étale restatement of `Pic0.semilinearComparison_cotangentSpaceDual_h1Cok`
256	(`Picard/Pic0AbelianVariety.lean`, a bare `sorry`): for every 2-affine cover `S`
257	of `C`, an additive equivalence between the dual of the cotangent space at the
258	identity of `Pic⁰_{C/k}` and the concrete two-chart Čech cokernel
259	`S.H1Cok (toModuleKSheaf C)`, together with a bijection `i` of the two scalar
260	rings intertwining the actions — exactly the data
261	`Pic0.finrank_eq_of_addEquiv_of_bijective_smul` consumes, and no more.
262	
263	`i` need only be a bijection of the underlying types, not a ring map: the
264	`κ(e)`-dimension of the left side is compared with the `k`-dimension of the right
265	side across the residue-field identification, so neither
266	`LinearEquiv.finrank_eq` nor `restrictScalars` applies.
267	
268	**Non-vacuity.** `C` occurs three times in the body — in the cover `S`, in the cotangent
269	space, and in the sheaf `toModuleKSheaf C` — so this is not the `HasDivFunctor` failure
270	mode, where the curve did not occur at all. It is a genuine two-sided constraint: it
271	implies a non-trivial `finrank` identity, and it is not satisfiable by making the left
272	carrier trivial (an `exact?` search cannot produce `Subsingleton` for it at these
273	hypotheses). At `genus C = 0` the *right* carrier does become trivial — see
274	`subsingleton_h1Cok_of_genus_eq_zero` below — but that discharges one carrier, not the
275	hypothesis.
276	
277	**The honest state, and what this hypothesis costs.** Two pieces of missing mathematics,
278	not one:
279	
280	1. what `Pic0AbelianVariety.lean` records at its own residue — exhibiting the map that
281	   sends a dual-number kernel class to its transition unit, i.e. a
282	   Čech-to-invertible-sheaves comparison at a *non-affine* scheme. Nothing here reduces
283	   that;
284	2. **and, specific to this side**, the passage between the sheafified kernel this
285	   comparison is stated against and the `relPresheaf` kernel that argument is about. See
286	   the module header: the `picSharp` residue's carrier is a quotient of
287	   `LineBundle.OnProduct`, this one's is a sheafification class, and the project has no
288	   lemma relating the two without a section.
289	
290	So the étale side needs one hypothesis rather than two, and needs nothing about a section —
291	but that hypothesis is strictly harder than its `picSharp` namesake, and clause 2 is why.
292	Recorded here rather than only in the inbox (`I-0989`) because a reader pricing future work
293	off this file would otherwise inherit the understatement. -/
294	def SemilinearCotangentComparisonEt (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
295	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
296	    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicSchemeEt C] : Prop :=
297	  ∀ S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare,
298	    ∃ (i : identityResidueField C → k)
299	      (j : Module.Dual (identityResidueField C) (identityCotangentSpace C)
300	            ≃+ S.H1Cok (Scheme.toModuleKSheaf C)),
301	      Function.Bijective i ∧ ∀ r x, j (r • x) = i r • j x
302	
303	/-- **The Kleiman §5 Thm. `thm:tgtsp` dimension identity for `Pic⁰_{C/k}`, étale
304	formulation**: `dim_{κ(e)} m_e/m_e² = dim_k H¹(C, 𝒪_C)` at the identity, with
305	**no rational point and no `[HasPicScheme C]`**.
306	
307	Stated as an implication from `SemilinearCotangentComparisonEt`, which is the
308	whole open content. The other two legs of the chain are discharged here:
309	
310	* `dim_{κ(e)} m_e/m_e² = dim_{κ(e)} Dual(m_e/m_e²)` — reflexivity of
311	  finite-dimensional duality (`Subspace.dual_finrank_eq`, finite-dimensionality
312	  from `finiteDimensional_cotangentSpace` above, i.e. from the unconditional
313	  `Pic0Et.locallyOfFiniteType`);
314	* `dim_k Ȟ¹(S, 𝒪_C) = dim_k H¹(C, 𝒪_C)` — the gate-free Mayer–Vietoris
315	  comparison `AffineCoverMVSquare.hModuleOneEquivH1Cok_curve`, at the 2-affine
316	  cover supplied unconditionally by
317	  `Adelic.exists_affineCoverMVSquare_module_finite_H1Cok`.
318	
319	Both of those legs are the *same* lemmas the pointed side uses, applied at
320	`Pic0SchemeEt`: they are generic in the scheme. Étale counterpart of
321	`Pic0.finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_finrank_hModuleOne`, which reports `sorryAx`
322	through its own residue. -/
323	theorem finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_finrank_hModuleOne (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
324	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
325	    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicSchemeEt C]
326	    (hcomp : SemilinearCotangentComparisonEt C) :
327	    Module.finrank (identityResidueField C) (identityCotangentSpace C)
328	      = Module.finrank k (Scheme.HModule k (Scheme.toModuleKSheaf C) 1) := by
329	  haveI := finiteDimensional_cotangentSpace C
330	  obtain ⟨S, -⟩ := Adelic.exists_affineCoverMVSquare_module_finite_H1Cok C
331	  obtain ⟨i, j, hi, hc⟩ := hcomp S
332	  calc Module.finrank (identityResidueField C) (identityCotangentSpace C)
333	      = Module.finrank (identityResidueField C)
334	          (Module.Dual (identityResidueField C) (identityCotangentSpace C)) :=
335	        Subspace.dual_finrank_eq.symm
336	    _ = Module.finrank k (S.H1Cok (Scheme.toModuleKSheaf C)) :=
337	        Pic0.finrank_eq_of_addEquiv_of_bijective_smul i j hi hc
338	    _ = Module.finrank k (Scheme.HModule k (Scheme.toModuleKSheaf C) 1) :=
339	        (LinearEquiv.finrank_eq S.hModuleOneEquivH1Cok_curve).symm
340	
341	/-- **The dimension count in the form the headline leaf needs**: the tangent
342	space at the identity of `Pic⁰_{C/k}` has dimension `genus C`.
343	
344	Immediate from the identity above, since `genus C` is *by definition*
345	`dim_k H¹(C, 𝒪_C)` (`AlgebraicJacobian/Genus.lean`) — the two sides match with no
346	transport, exactly as on the pointed side.
347	
348	This is the number `smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus_pic0Et` (`Jacobian.lean`)
349	needs. It is **not** that leaf: the leaf additionally needs `Pic0Et.smooth` and
350	the passage from a tangent-space dimension to Mathlib's presentation-based
351	`SmoothOfRelativeDimension` (characterised by `Module.rank S Ω[S⁄R]`), neither of
352	which is touched here. What this removes from the leaf's cost is the transport
353	along a section that its docstring claimed to require. -/
354	theorem finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_genus (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
355	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
356	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicSchemeEt C]
357	    (hcomp : SemilinearCotangentComparisonEt C) :
358	    Module.finrank (identityResidueField C) (identityCotangentSpace C) = genus C :=
359	  finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_finrank_hModuleOne C hcomp
360	
361	/-- **Half of the antecedent is free at `genus C = 0`, and the other half is not** —
362	recorded as a theorem so the boundary is measured rather than asserted.
363	
364	At genus `0` the Čech side of `SemilinearCotangentComparisonEt` is `Subsingleton` for
365	*every* 2-affine cover, unconditionally: `genus C` is by definition
366	`dim_k H¹(C, 𝒪_C)`, so `genus C = 0` gives `Subsingleton (H¹(C, 𝒪_C))` by
367	`Module.finrank_zero_iff` (legitimate here because the genus carrier is a finite
368	`k`-module, `Adelic.instModuleFiniteHModuleOne`), and the gate-free Mayer–Vietoris
369	equivalence carries that to `S.H1Cok`.
370	
371	**What this does not give**, and it is the reason the antecedent stays open even in the
372	degenerate case: the *other* side of the comparison is the dual of the cotangent space at
373	the identity of `Pic⁰_{C/k}`, and nothing in the tree makes that `Subsingleton` — an
374	`exact?` search at exactly these hypotheses fails. Making it vanish is the assertion that
375	`Pic⁰_{C/k}` is `0`-dimensional, which is the conclusion the comparison is *for*. So
376	`genus C = 0` does not inhabit the antecedent; it discharges one of its two carriers.
377	
378	This is worth a declaration because the natural next move on a hypothesis like this is to
379	look for a degenerate instantiation, and here that move gets exactly halfway. -/
380	theorem subsingleton_h1Cok_of_genus_eq_zero (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
381	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
382	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
383	    (hg : genus C = 0) (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare) :
384	    Subsingleton (S.H1Cok (Scheme.toModuleKSheaf C)) := by
385	  have h0 : Module.finrank k (Scheme.HModule k (Scheme.toModuleKSheaf C) 1) = 0 := hg
386	  haveI : Subsingleton (Scheme.HModule k (Scheme.toModuleKSheaf C) 1) :=
387	    Module.finrank_zero_iff.mp h0
388	  exact Function.Injective.subsingleton
389	    (f := (S.hModuleOneEquivH1Cok_curve (C := C)).symm) (LinearEquiv.injective _)
390	
391	/-! ## §4. The keystone: `T₀ Pic⁰_{C/k} ≅ H¹(C, 𝒪_C)` -/

  geometrically_isReduced : geometrically IsReduced f

  MorphismProperty.pullback_snd f g inferInstance

theorem Algebra.IsStandardSmooth.isReduced_of_isDomain (B S : Type*) [CommRing B] [CommRing S]
    [IsDomain B] [Algebra B S] [Algebra.IsStandardSmooth B S] : IsReduced S :=
  (RingHom.isStandardSmooth_algebraMap.mpr ‹_›).isReduced_of_isDomain

end RingTheory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open CategoryTheory Limits

variable {X Y : Scheme.{u}}

/-- A scheme smooth over the spectrum of a field is reduced. -/
theorem Smooth.isReduced_of_field {K : Type u} [Field K] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [Smooth f] :
    IsReduced X := by
  have hsub : Subsingleton (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum K))
  choose U hU V hV hxV e hsm using Smooth.exists_isStandardSmooth f
  -- Each chart is the spectrum of a standard smooth algebra over (a ring isomorphic to) `K`,
  -- hence reduced.
  have hred (x : X) : IsReduced (V x).toScheme := by
    have : IsAffine (V x).toScheme := hV x
    have hfx : f x ∈ U x := e x (hxV x)
    have hUx : U x = ⊤ := by
      refine TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext (Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun y ↦ ?_)
      exact Subsingleton.elim (f x) y ▸ hfx
    have hdom : IsDomain Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), U x) := by
      rw [hUx]
      exact Function.Injective.isDomain
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv (RingEquiv.injective _)
    have hΓ : _root_.IsReduced Γ(X, V x) := (hsm x).isReduced_of_isDomain
    have : _root_.IsReduced Γ((V x).toScheme, ⊤) :=
      isReduced_of_injective (V x).topIso.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv (RingEquiv.injective _)
    exact isReduced_of_isAffine_isReduced _
  let 𝒰 : X.OpenCover := Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers X (fun x ↦ (V x).toScheme) (fun x ↦ (V x).ι)
    (fun x ↦ ⟨x, ⟨x, hxV x⟩, rfl⟩) (fun x ↦ inferInstance)
  have : ∀ i, IsReduced (𝒰.X i) := hred
  exact IsReduced.of_openCover _ 𝒰

/-- A smooth morphism of schemes is geometrically reduced: every base change to the spectrum
of a field is smooth over that field, hence reduced. -/
instance (priority := 100) Smooth.geometricallyReduced (f : X ⟶ Y) [Smooth f] :
    GeometricallyReduced f where
  geometrically_isReduced := fun K _ y Z fst snd h ↦
    have : Smooth snd := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @Smooth) h ‹Smooth f›
    Smooth.isReduced_of_field snd

/-- A morphism smooth of relative dimension `1` is smooth. This is the relative dimension of
the curve bundle of the Jacobian challenge; the general statement is
`SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth`, which cannot be an instance since `n` does not occur in
the conclusion. -/
instance (priority := 100) Smooth.of_smoothOfRelativeDimension_one (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] : Smooth f :=
  SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth 1 f
